purpose: Teach: バイヤー/打診/催促/充て/固める/アシスト/前文/一筋

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 創業期、本気で、絶対、お父さん、絶対、海外バイヤー、絶対、自分で、絶対、開拓したぞ、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: When we started out, I went myself — absolutely, seriously — and developed our overseas buyers from the ground up.
lines.style: Steady, measured delivery. Quiet pride beneath the surface. Each 'absolutely' lands with quiet weight, not emphasis. Long measured pauses between clauses. Voice of memory, not performance.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんの代から、本気で、絶対、お得意様の、絶対、打診、絶対、丁寧に、絶対、対応してまいりました、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. Since my father's time, we've treated every valued customer with absolute care and respect in every approach. I'm truly grateful for that foundation.
lines.style: Formal respect, but genuine underneath. Measured cadence matching the elder's rhythm. Each commitment lands with steady conviction. Final gratitude is sincere, not ceremonial.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、本気で、絶対、催促、絶対、しなくとも、絶対、お客様、絶対、信頼してくれたぞ、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: Your father had a gift — he could build such strong conviction in his beliefs that customers trusted him without ever needing to chase them.
lines.style: Soft, distant tone. Voice of someone remembering clearly. Slight wonder in the voice — acknowledging something he's still learning. Quiet, unhurried pacing.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんの代から、本気で、絶対、利益、絶対、社員に、絶対、充てる、絶対、こと、絶対、大切にしてきました、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. Since my father's time, we've made it our principle to give back the profits to our staff. That belief has stayed constant, and I'm grateful for it.
lines.style: Quiet conviction. Not grand — this is stated as simple fact, not flourish. Steady pace. Gratitude at the close is measured and true.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、本気で、絶対、信念を、絶対、固める、絶対、ことが、絶対、得意だったぞ、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: Your father was remarkable at holding firm to his principles — at steadying himself and others around that belief.
lines.style: Soft, distant. Voice of clear memory and deep regard. Slight trailing-off as if marveling at the quality he's describing. Quiet respect underneath.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんの代から、本気で、絶対、社員同士、絶対、アシスト、絶対、する、絶対、文化、絶対、続いております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. My father's spirit lives in how we work — devoted, single-minded, one thread running through everything. I carry that forward with gratitude.
lines.style: Solemn, present-tense voice. Each phrase builds on the last. Quiet intensity underneath the formality. Final gratitude is weighted with genuine responsibility.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さんの、本気で、絶対、社訓の、絶対、前文、絶対、ばあさん、絶対、覚えていたぞ、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: Even your grandmother remembered the opening words of your father's company creed. That stayed with her all these years.
lines.style: Soft, wondering tone. Voice touching on memory with gentle care. Slight emphasis on 'remembered' — marveling at the power of those words to endure. Quiet reverence.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんの精神、本気で、絶対、業務に、絶対、一筋に、絶対、受け継いでまいります、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. I carry my father's spirit into every task — devoted, unwavering, a single purpose. That's what I'm passing on, with deep gratitude.
lines.style: Quiet, solemn close. Voice of someone accepting responsibility. Measured, deliberate pace. Each phrase echoes the weight of inheritance. Final gratitude carries the gravity of continuing a legacy.
